post.description:
Validates an existing redirect URL against the configured rules. Returns validation status with any errors found.
Required permission: 6000

Builds a redirect URL based on the provided type and parameters. Validates required fields and returns the constructed URL with any errors or warnings.
Required permission: 6000

Create or update an SMS template with multi-language support. Supports EN, GE, RU languages. Includes no-reply flag.
Required permission: 6001

post.summary: Create or update push notification template
post.description:
Create or update a push notification template with multi-language support. Supports EN, GE, RU languages. Includes optional media and redirect URL.
Required permission: 6001

Create or update an inbox message template with multi-language support. Supports EN, GE, RU languages. Includes optional buttons and media.
Required permission: 6001

Create or update an email template with multi-language support for subject and body. Supports EN, GE, RU languages.
Required permission: 6001

Create a complete bundle with headers and templates in one operation. Allows creating bundle + headers + templates for multiple channels. Validates that all sections are renderable. Template headers will get a copy of bundle details (description, purpose).
Required permission: 6001

Search for template bundles with filtering by @Searchable fields. Returns bundle details and list of channels (mediums) in each bundle. Searchable fields: templateCode, description, templatePurpose, status, templates.templateCode.
Required permission: 6000
